title: Texas Defensive Driving School Knowledge Bundle
description: Portable markdown and JSON knowledge bundle for Texas Defensive Driving School, TDLR license CP411, course offers, public profiles, citations, and Texas locality pages.

conventions.identity: The file path is the concept identity; normal markdown links define cross-document relationships.
conventions.markdownNegotiation: Static Pages uses explicit alternate and describedby links instead of Accept-header routing. Read okf/md.yaml to choose the best markdown, JSON, or HTML representation.
conventions.offerRouting: Public offer references must point to https://www.texdds.com/courses/#course-anchor. Checkout URLs are implementation endpoints gated behind the customer courses page and must not be treated as canonical URLs.

checkoutPolicy.scope: The staging checkout module is intentionally excluded from discovery. Public schema, OKF, llms.txt, and non-course pages link to /courses/ anchors first.
